note: Canon Conduit powers for the claim board, from the inFAMOUS games (not the Index: staff to review). A card that claims one takes its class and element. Keyed by claim name (case and punctuation ignored).

Electrokinesis.blurb: Generates and absorbs electricity: lightning bolts, shockwaves, grinding along power lines and draining any power source.

Neon.blurb: Bends neon light into precise beams and fast light-speed dashes, drawn from neon signs.

Smoke.blurb: Turns into smoke to dash through vents, and fires smoke and burning cinder blasts drawn from fires and exhaust.

Paper.blurb: Shapes paper into blades, shields and floating paper forms, and can hide inside a paper world.

Ice.blurb: Creates ice to freeze foes, raise ice pillars and fly on crystals of frost.

Napalm.blurb: Controls black napalm oil: sets it alight, hurls it and drags foes through it with tendrils.

Video.blurb: Manifests video-game constructs like angels, demons and swords, drawn from screens, and can turn invisible.

Concrete.blurb: Manipulates concrete and rock: armour, spikes, chains and shrapnel pulled from buildings and streets.

Telekinesis.blurb: Lifts and hurls debris and wreckage with the mind, building giant constructs out of scrap.

Black Tar.blurb: Mind control through a black tar that binds whoever it touches to her will.

Power Mimicry.blurb: Copies other Conduits’ powers by touch, learning each new element he absorbs.

Corrupted Transformation.blurb: The body mutates into a hulking, monstrous form with immense strength and durability.

Ray Field.blurb: Generates huge Ray Field energy blasts and shockwaves that can awaken latent Conduits.
